name: mergdowntotex
description:
Merge & doc. export everything — embeds, Zotero/Pandoc citations, Mermaid, equations, cross-refs — into a unique .tex file. Compile to PDF, DOCX, or InDesign. WASM engine, zero build step.

• Vault exemple : https://dvrch.github.io/mergdown2tex/assets/full_manual_repport_exp.zip
• Plugin complet (zip) : https://dvrch.github.io/mergdown2tex/assets/mergdowntotex.zip
• Documentation : https://dvrch.github.io/mergdown2tex/
